title: Executive Reporting & Board Narrative Generator
rationale: Executives need narrative trend analysis, not raw data. This AI-heavy feature builds on top of all other modules (findings, incidents, testing, evidence) and is best built after those data sources exist. Deferred because it is a presentation layer on top of operational data that doesn't yet exist.

user_stories.story: As a CISO, I want to generate a quarterly board-ready compliance report with one click, so that I don't spend days building slide decks.
acceptance_criteria: System generates a narrative report covering: compliance score trend, key risks, findings velocity, regulatory changes.
Report is exportable as PDF and PowerPoint.

user_stories.story: As an Executive, I want to see risk trend analysis and forecasted exposure by geography, so that I can make strategic resource allocation decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows risk exposure trends over 6/12 months.
Filterable by jurisdiction, framework, and department.
AI provides brief explanations for significant trend changes.

user_stories.story: As a CISO, I want the report to include control maturity scoring and remediation velocity metrics, so that I can demonstrate program improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes control maturity progression (if PRD-F09 implemented).
Report includes evidence freshness and testing coverage metrics.
